chunks: But did not find more than a single family of believers.

key_terms.الْمُسْلِمِينَ: the believers (those who submit to God)

ai.seo_question: Who was the single family of believers found in the city?
ai.summary: In the context of the destruction of Sodom, this verse underscores the rarity of monotheism, a theme often cited by Shia scholars to illustrate the concept of *Qalil al-Mu'minin* (the few believers) amidst widespread corruption. It serves as a reminder that divine salvation is not guaranteed by majority but by the steadfastness of the faithful, such as Lot's household, who remained distinct from the prevailing idolatry.
